recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR-13290 core-source follow-up is needed unless the work group opens a new issue to revisit the broader performer/onBehalfOf pattern or to address unrelated editorial wording.
issue_request: FHIR-13290 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Immunization change request to allow representing the organization responsible for administering an immunization when the individual practitioner is unknown. The motion expanded practitioner.actor to include Organization, renamed practitioner to performer, and proposed onBehalfOf; the application comment says R4 included Organization and the performer rename but did not add onBehalfOf because the Event pattern changed.
initial_application: No commit subject explicitly naming FHIR-13290 was found. The apparent application is f451f3fc4b093f23541fadb82141a50def0e1cc5, which added #13290 committee notes to Immunization.performer, Immunization.performer.function, and Immunization.performer.actor and set actor to Reference(Practitioner | Organization). Later source rework preserved those notes in the current StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: Immunization is active in source/fhir.ini, historical Immunization.practitioner names map to Immunization.performer, and current Immunization.performer.actor includes Practitioner, PractitionerRole, Organization, Patient, and RelatedPerson. The Patient and RelatedPerson targets come from later Published issue FHIR-32773. No current Immunization onBehalfOf element exists, matching the FHIR-13290 application comment that the Event pattern no longer used it.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative StructureDefinition and search parameter already convey that an Immunization performer can be an organization, and adding onBehalfOf now would conflict with the recorded R4 application rationale.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive Immunization issue broadened Immunization.performer.actor to include Patient and RelatedPerson, explaining why current actor targets are wider than FHIR-13290's Practitioner/Organization scope.
